name: stochasticTiling
description: Seamlessly warps the UV0 ('Tiled') texture coordinates with a random vector field and modulates the base color over a large scale to break up visible texture repetition. UV1 ('Unwrapped') is not affected.

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Enables stochastic tiling for UV0. Disabled by default.

properties.name: strength
properties.description: How strongly the texture coordinates are warped. Higher values break up repetition more, but can visibly stretch texture details.

properties.name: scale
properties.description: Frequency of the warp field. Lower values spread the distortion over more tiles (smoother), higher values make it more chaotic.

properties.name: variationStrength
properties.description: Modulates the base color brightness over a large, world-space scale that is independent of the texture tiling. Very effective against repetition at a distance. 0 disables.

properties.name: variationScale
properties.description: World-space size of a macro variation patch, in meters.

properties.name: tilingBlendingEnabled
properties.description: Enables stochastic tiling and blending (Deliot/Heitz) for the base color. Requires a Gaussianized texture and inverse LUT generated with the stochastic_preprocess tool, imported as linear (non-sRGB). Overrides the UV warp for the base color while active.

properties.name: gaussianMap
properties.description: Histogram-transformed (Gaussianized) version of the base color texture, generated by the stochastic_preprocess tool. Must be imported as linear (non-sRGB).

properties.name: inverseLut
properties.description: Prefiltered inverse histogram lookup table generated by the stochastic_preprocess tool. Must be imported as linear (non-sRGB).

properties.name: colorSpaceOrigin
properties.description: Decorrelated color space origin from the stochastic_preprocess tool.

properties.name: colorSpaceAxis1
properties.description: Decorrelated color space axis 1 from the stochastic_preprocess tool.

properties.name: colorSpaceAxis2
properties.description: Decorrelated color space axis 2 from the stochastic_preprocess tool.

properties.name: colorSpaceAxis3
properties.description: Decorrelated color space axis 3 from the stochastic_preprocess tool.
